title: helenium arbuscula
intro: Helenium arbuscula, commonly known as Rocky Mountain sunflower, is a perennial plant species belonging to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Helenium arbuscula include its ability to soothe digestive issues and alleviate menstrual cramps, thanks to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. These constituents are responsible for its therapeutic effects, making it a potential herbal remedy for various health conditions.
